items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: But anyway he talked to me and he said, “You know there’s a lot of things you could do with a music degree.”

ctx.x: And this was at what school?

This was Rutgers University in Newark. Yeah. So I went over there because I got accepted to Rutgers. So I figured okay fine, this is good, I will go to Rutgers and be an English major. But anyway he talked to me and he said, “You know there’s a lot of things you could do with a music degree.” And he was trying to talk to me about becoming part of the department. And he gave me this sheet of paper that had all the different types of jobs you could get if you got a music degree. And I was floored. Because I figured…
classical things. I chose “Moonlight Serenade.” That was my audition piece. Because I knew —
